entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this useless VeloBand thing I bought. I'm looking at my order number right now, so let's just get this over with.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference? What kind of question is that? It doesn't work for me! I just want my money back. I simply changed my mind, okay? It was a stupid impulse buy and I don't use it. This shouldn't be this complicated!

I understand your frustration, and I'm sorry to hear it wasn't the right fit for you. I just need to ask those questions to follow our process. Can you please provide me with your order number so I can pull up your account?

Fine. It's VF886-09B. And don't give me the runaround. If I don't get a return label by the end of this call, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. I expect a full refund.
Thank you. One moment while I review your order... Okay, I see your VeloBand Cadence Sensor was delivered on December 21st, 2025. Is that correct?
I don't know, it was about a month ago! Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager?

That won't be necessary. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that full refund for you right now. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address on file as we speak.
Oh. So... it's approved? Just like that?

Yes, absolutely. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see the full refund credited to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. The instructions are in the email I just sent.
Okay. Well... good. That's what I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
